annotations.title: Prepare a Bridge to Earn task

description: Prepares one open Bridge to Earn task for an address, from OrbitWan's own reads: the address's WAN and the WAN pledge on Wanchain, the claimTask call with our node's eth_call of it from the address, the address's task token and native balance on the source chain, the XFlows quote and request body, every funding requirement with have, need and short, ready, and the reward's options in WAN. With source_tx alone it adds sign_request, the exact call to the board's signer; with source_tx and signature it also builds the claimReward call and its eth_call, and offers it only when that eth_call passes. Copy figures and calldata exactly as returned; a null is unknown, never zero. When the task's source or destination chain is not EVM (Tron, Solana, Bitcoin, Cardano, XRP Ledger, Sui), pass your own address on that chain as source_address or dest_address, copied from your wallet; it is never derived from the 0x address. The wanchain-bridge-to-earn skill gives the full workflow.
name: prepare_bridge_to_earn
